# DevCenterPoint

> DevCenterPoint is a digital product and systems engineering studio designing and developing full-stack SaaS platforms, AI-powered intelligent systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and high-performance business applications.

## Core Capabilities
- [Product Engineering](https://devcenterpoint.com/#capabilities): Full-stack SaaS, modern web applications, high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and legacy modernization.
- [AI & Intelligent Systems](https://devcenterpoint.com/#capabilities): Practical machine learning, SHAP/LIME explainability, LLM API integration, RAG workflows, predictive data ingestion.
- [Experience Design](https://devcenterpoint.com/#capabilities): Token-driven design systems, high-density interfaces, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05).
- [Business Systems](https://devcenterpoint.com/#capabilities): Custom ERP, POS, B2B CRM, inventory/WMS, immutable audit logs, offline-first sync.
- [Commerce Infrastructure](https://devcenterpoint.com/#capabilities): Headless e-commerce, multi-vendor marketplaces, Stripe payment gateway switches, sub-second checkout speeds.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://devcenterpoint.com/#capabilities): Kubernetes, Docker, automated CI/CD pipelines, zero-downtime blue/green and canary deployments.

## Verified Production Metrics
- Uptime SLA: 99.98% production availability
- API Latency Target: <50ms server response
- Code Quality Gates: 100% strict TypeScript compilation with zero `any` exemptions
- Feature Velocity: 65% faster time-to-market via modular architecture

## Case Studies
- [MediTrack OS](https://devcenterpoint.com/#work): Clinical workflow and patient triage platform serving 140+ clinics with sub-100ms load times and HIPAA-grade encryption.
- [Apex Logistics Cloud](https://devcenterpoint.com/#work): Real-time freight dispatch and telematics engine tracking 12,000+ active fleet units with sub-second WebSocket telemetry.
- [OmniPay Gateway](https://devcenterpoint.com/#work): Multi-currency fintech payment switch processing $4.2M+ monthly transaction volume with zero-loss atomic idempotency.
- [AuraRetail Commerce](https://devcenterpoint.com/#work): Enterprise headless marketplace achieving 99/100 Lighthouse performance and sub-800ms international checkouts.

## Commercial Engagement Models
- Dedicated Engineering Squads: Cross-functional senior engineers, software architect, and delivery lead embedded into your workflows.
- Fixed-Scope Milestone Tranches: Guaranteed-budget execution with deterministic phase sign-offs.
- Fractional CTO & Systems Advisory: High-leverage architecture audits, technology selection, and technical leadership.
